summary: Category rail on the Perps tab and shared filter predicate look sound. PR description and manual steps still describe horizontal scroll and FilterSelect, which HEAD replaced with a More menu and PerpsCategoryRail. More menu still does not move focus into the list when selectedId is null.

comments.body: This rail never scrolls horizontally. Overflow goes to More. The PR description and manual testing step 3 still tell reviewers to narrow the window and confirm overflow-x-auto. Update those docs (and any leftover recipe) to the More-menu path so QA does not fail a correct build.

Manual testing step 4 still says the filter dropdown should read Crypto. FilterSelect is gone. This rail is the destination (`testId="market-list-categories"`). Ask reviewers to check the Crypto pill is active here, not `filter-select-button`.

Opening the menu only focuses an option when `selectedIndex >= 0`. The category More menu always passes `selectedId={null}`, so Enter/Space/Arrow on the trigger open the listbox without moving focus into it. Arrow handling on options never runs until something in the menu is focused. Focus index 0 (or the first option) when the menu opens with no selection, so overflowed categories stay keyboard-reachable. Tab can still land on the option buttons, but that is not listbox behavior.
